ascension-of-the-sylvan-cosmos:
Follow the story of Tianlian Liu Shu, a tree who didn't know anything at first and struggles to survive and extend her roots through the cosmos.
The World she lives in is filled with fantastic sights and strange new cultures, and there is something everybody in this World has: A system.
Moreover, even while she is a tree, she has people who will fawn over her...?
“Tiantian, does the Sun feel good on your leaves today?”
“Liu Liu, I've found this delicious compost made of natural extract~.”
“Tian'er, does the wind feel good on your branches?”
Tianlian Liu Shu, a female tree, didn't really know what to do with these fawning women.
back-to-the-1970s-building-my-fortune-th:
Waking up, Su Xiaoxiao lands in 1970s—ration cards, empty markets, six mouths to feed, only two working adults.
Coarse sorghum is a luxury and her grandmother wants to sell her to the village chief’s simple-minded son for two hundred yuan.
Xiaoxiao’s lifeline: a “time-trading” app that links her phone to 2024.
She orders cheap bulk goods—cooking oil, canned meat, even light bulbs—and resells them at 1970s prices, pocketing the difference.
Every deal earns her “time-credits” she can cash in for more stock.
Others cling to their secure jobs while barely managing to eat, but Su Xiaoxiao's family becomes the wealthiest in the county by engaging in the individual economy that others despise.
bro-im-not-an-undead:
Bro!
You wouldn’t believe this!
Everything was normal. Me and my bros doing some mining for mana gems for that old sockethole, Somanda like we always do all day, everyday.
Me, Fractures, Bonet, Mono-socket, Broadbone and the gang.
Then from nowhere, that ungrateful sockethole, Somanda tries to END me! Can you believe that?!

RIGHT?!

A voice speaks to me about how I have qualified for something about a something that’s supposedly something’s something!
Then I find myself in a new world that reeks of life and gives my bones a disgusted rattle.…
claimed-by-the-mafia-don:
He is one of the most feared Mafia Don, built on blood, vengeance and silence. She is someone from a world he never planned to enter, or so he thought.
Nero has a simple plan. Never fall in love. Never show weakness. And avenge his mother's death.
He has been living according to his plans until he met her, Zoe Dean. A girl that shouldn't matter to him, but eventually she did.
And now, with enemies closing in, and his past catching up. He must choose: Forgiveness or Vengeance
Love or Legacy
Rise or Fall
Kill or Be Killed.
BOOK TROPES
Dark romance
Touch her and you die
Beauty and the beast vibes

divine-system-land-of-the-abominations:
In the heavens, where the Divinity resides, there exists the records of life and death.
After the fall of the Gryghori onto the earth, the land of man is corrupted. Abominable creatures never before seen are born of the consummation of heavenly and earthly beings and spread across the land to further corrupt the world.
A thousand millennia later, humanity has created civilization once again, based on the knowledge left behind by these Fallen Angels.
However, in this new civilization,
Man is not alone.
Nero is thrown into a world infested with demons, the souls of the dead Nephilim, and abominations of all shapes and horrors, when he stumbles across the very eye of the Divine.
A story that preludes an apocalypse and the existence of slumbering evil that threatens to envelop the earth begins.
This isn't a story of fulfillment or triumph.
These are the very Records of the beginning of the end.
Welcome— To the Land of the Abominations.
eternal-tale:
【Light-hearted and humorous + No female lead + No knives + Survivalist protagonist】- caution, this story is engaging.
Chen Xun traversed into the vast and boundless world of cultivation, awakening the Immortal Ascension System, which unexpectedly granted him a companion, a long-lived spiritual beast.
I, Chen Xun, have no interest in fighting or killing, nor do I wish to provoke anyone. I only want to travel the world with my old ox and witness all the worldly splendors. However, one day, I inadvertently discovered a secret….
evil-venerable-of-the-sword-dao:
Zhou Yan was a prodigy son to the once infamous genius.
Despite being the son to an extremely skilled and talented father, he was born untalented and crude.
It seemed that no matter how hard he had struggled, he would end up disappointing everyone who had high hopes for him.
However, something unexpected happened to him on one fateful evening of his arduous training—he had inherited the will and knowledge of a mysterious old sage.
Through that encounter, his skill and powers improved by several folds.
Follow our main protagonist in his exciting journey to become who he was meant to be!
extreme-pampering-after-marriage:
Xu Youyou, daughter of the Xu family who had been sent to the countryside to nurse her health years ago, had returned to uphold the marriage promise with the Lin family. On the eve of her wedding, the groom escaped abroad in search of his dream girl. The crowd gasped and watched on excitedly.
Xu Youyou’s only comment was, “Okay.” The next instant, her fair hands had seized the collar of a man’s shirt as she asked sweetly, “Mr. Mo, can you marry me?” The business tycoon, Mo Shenbai, was aloof, abstinent, mysterious, and kept a low profile. Having dominated the challenging business industry for ten years, no media was bold enough to post a picture of him, and no woman was able to catch his eye.
Everyone said that Mo Shenbai’s marriage with Xu Youyou was only a contract, and they would surely divorce after a year. Xu Youyou was happily reading these rumors about her, but then she noticed something was off, She didn’t have to pay for her shopping, nor choose her food, and everyone would ardently greet her wherever she went, calling her “Mrs. Xu.” Then, Mo Shenbai’s dream girl came back, and Xu Youyou’s ex-fiance confessed, “Youyou, only my love for you is true.
Come back to me.…
from-dying-in-the-apocalypse-to-being-ch:
After dying in a zombie apocalypse, betrayed by the teammates he trusted most, Ethan wakes up inside the body of the weakest Guide in the Empire.
Mocked by everyone. Abandoned by his family. Publicly rejected by Lord Drey, his S-Class Sentinel fiancé.
Perfect.
This life, Ethan wants only one thing. A quiet life.
Accidentally becoming the only person capable of guiding the Empire’s strongest Sentinel?
…That wasn’t part of the plan.
After a monster attack forces Ethan to guide the very man who rejected him, he does the impossible—completely purifying corruption that no other Guide can cleanse.
Then Ethan discovers an even bigger problem.
Once he Guides a Sentinel…
No other Guide can ever Guide them again.
And so, avoiding Sentinels becomes his number one priority. Too bad they keep chasing him.
Now the Empire believes the weakest Guide is stealing its strongest Sentinels. The academy is watching him. Powerful factions want to claim him.
And worst of all, the same man who wanted nothing to do with him suddenly can’t accept guidance from anyone else and refuses to let anyone else near Ethan.
All Ethan wanted was to graduate peacefully.…
global-evolution-i-super-double-up-on-my:
Transferred to the all-inclusive evolution game “Playful Mountains and Seas”, only to become a weakling drained by a Fox Demon?
Right from the start, my class teacher advised me to drop out and enroll in Lanxiang's Kai Tian Pi Di Machine major, in order not to drag down the college entrance rate?
You, with innate cheats after the transfer, are completely unfazed by this - you even want to laugh. It's just evolution, all it takes is hands!
You stretch lazily after waking up, HP+1+1+1...... your flesh achieves sainthood, able to fly sky-high and burrow deep into the ground, with a fist that can shatter stars.
You zone out aimlessly, Spirit +1+1+1...... words becoming reality, a thought changes seas, another thought transforms fields.
You indulge a craving and eat a cucumber, Evolution +1+1+1...... one year for legendary, two years for epic, three years for mythical.
PS: Alternate titles include “Beat the Fox Demon at the Start”, “Top Scholar Needs Only Hands”, “At Home, I Only Play, Never Exercise”, “Everyone's Physical Constitution Varies”.
global-job-change-starting-with-the-hidd:
Mutations occurred around the whole world and soon, a demonic apocalypse befell.
In order to defend against demonic beings, humans swiftly entered a globalized digital age. Everyone would be able to choose between a fighting or a supporting job through awakening once they reached the age of 18. These people would get stronger by slaying demonic beings.
Lu Yan had awakened to the weakest job, a Necromancer. However, he had also received a Job Supporting System and was able to reawaken into a hidden job, Lord of the Death.
“Necromancers are so weak that they die in one hit!”
“Man, that dude’s luck is just the worst. He did get a fighting job, but it’s the weakest. What can he do? Summon a few skeletons?”
“Also, aren’t there only like a handful of Necromancers out there? There aren’t a lot of experience or resources for them to inherit. Their future seems bleak.”
“Forget Necromancers! I got the Holy Knight job! Your all-around king is here!”
Not long after that, Lu Yan appeared in a full set of Death Nether Armor while wielding the Death Soul Scythe and leading a 100 thousand-strong death army. With a single swing of his scythe, he split the mythical rank demonic beast in half.…
harem-of-the-dora-prince:
“Dragon-riding” Prince Craft returned to the imperial capital after traveling around. Refraining from his coronation, he received marriage proposals from each country.
Although Craft dislikes marriage, he established the “Bride Training Department” and he will marry the woman who remained at last. If it’s done at all, it’s fascinating!
In front of Craft who volunteered to be the lecturer and the referee of this training department, each lovely and perfect bride appeared one after another!
A positive female pervert-like cousin, a glamorous beast girl, a black-haired swordsman with ponytail, a blond small breasted princess and a tanned and lively girl with big breasts. These 5 girls approach Craft! A expressionless maid and a brave loli halfsister join the tumult, too!
Who does the Dora Prince choose!? How about all of them! This is the start of a harem, romantic and comedy story!!
hogwarts-era-of-darkness:
When the First Wizarding War ended, and Lord Voldemort chased out Dumbledore from Hogwarts, he became the undisputed leader of the Wizarding World, cementing his rule as the new Minister of Magic. Yet everyone in power knew the war was far from over; it was now waged behind closed curtains and under the table. Behind the veil of secrecy, those still loyal to Dumbledore continued to fight, waging guerilla-like warfare against him and his forces, drawing in other countries' wizards and witches, opposing Voldemort and his plans to dominate all magic.
The Anguine family, home of pure-blood wizards, part of Voldemort's new Ministry of Magic, were often tasked with confronting the Order of the Phoenix, raising their reputation year by year. Born into the Anguine family, Conrad just came to age, ready to attend Hogwarts to start his studies. He was excited to go to a school he had heard about from his father many times, but times have changed. It is not like in the old days. But who knows? One day, the school may return to what it was before the Era of Darkness.…
hypnosis-can-pure-love-bloom-with-a-stun:
Thanks to my hypnosis app, I’ve gotten closer to Mom and Big Sis. Not only mentally, but also physically! Plus, every time I pull off a successful hypnosis, I earn points that awaken my powers! i-can-peek-inside-every-place-and-even-r:

In all his years of cultivation, he was never able to live like the main character. There was no day without suffering until one day, he obtained one of the Legendary Nine Heavenly Treasures - the Eyes of Heaven.

i-the-all-class-magus-all-my-awakening-s:
A hundred years ago, the virtual and the real merged, unleashing countless monsters across dimensions, revealing mysterious dungeons, and heralding the descent of dark gods upon humanity.
The world entered an age of darkness.
A century later, John transmigrate into this era of universal awakening, awakening the SSS-level talent [Divine Favor Tome] and transitioning into the god-tier class [All-Class Magus]!

That girl's smile, the way she talked to him, and her eyes full of genuine affection... they were all he needed to become the person he was.

invincible-kungfu-healer:
In his past lifetime, he was an exceptional prodigy who practiced both medicine and martial arts. In this lifetime, on earth, he used his superb medical expertise and extreme martial arts achievements from his past lifetime to excel in the medical field and the ancient martial arts world. He moved his way towards the pinnacle!
A fine youngster, who had been frequently looked down upon due to his poverty, had gone through the cold and warmth of this world to lament laughingly that life was merely so. However, he accidentally awakened the memory of his past lifetime. Since then, for three incarnations, he enjoyed prosperity.
lord-of-entertainment:
In a world of magic and monsters, I carved out my own empire. Hellfire Studios - my brainchild, my legacy.
It all started with “The Demonfather” - a blatant copy from my past life, sure, but this world had never seen anything like it. Humans, elves, dwarves - they all fell in love with it. Critics raved, audiences cheered, and suddenly, I was on top.
But the world thought I was a one-hit wonder. They had no idea what was coming.
I unleashed “The Lord of the Rings” upon them. The result? Critics were left speechless, fumbling for words to describe what they'd witnessed
But why stop at movies? This world was stuck in the past, so I dragged it into the future. I created computers, birthed video games, and watched as everyone from imps to elf elders became addicted to pixels and polygons.
Still not satisfied, I turned to music. I crafted stars, produced hits, and soon had the entire realm dancing to my tunes.
But even that wasn't enough. Comics, manga, cartoons, anime, novels - I introduced them all. I flooded this world with stories and art forms they'd never dreamed of.
Before long, people weren't just consuming my creations - they begun worshipping me.…
lord-system-reborn-as-the-genius-heir-to:
Living an unfulfilled life, Zack Gray meets an untimely end–that is, until he’s given a second chance, in a new world, under a new name: “Leon Schoeller.” Heir to the Schoeller Estate, a powerful and prestigious noble family, a life of luxury surrounded by maids and butlers of elite skills of their own awaits the reborn man.
[Lord System Activated.]
In addition to being blessed with a genius mind and magical talent, the [Lord System] grants Leon supernatural abilities, from empowering his servants, conquering beasts, and even manipulating his mansion.
However, as gifted as he finds himself, the world around him is full of lurking threats, forcing him to level up if he expects to keep his cozy life intact.
lust-dominion-the-ultimate-harem-system:
WARNING: [ FEATURES MATURE EXPLICIT CONTENT / R-18 ]
He died a nobody.
He woke up in a rotting orphanage with a System that only cares about one thing:
Desire.
Every glance.
Every touch.
Every filthy thought he shouldn’t have.
The Lust Dominion System turns lust into power, obsession into strength, and the women he claims into living anchors for his growth. The more he wants them, the stronger he becomes. The more he takes, the harder the world tries to break him.
In the lower district, soft people get sold and strong people get buried. Kai Voss starts with nothing but a scarred mercenary watching his back, a stubborn orphan girl who keeps choosing him anyway, and a System that rewards every dark impulse he stops pretending he doesn’t have.
Factions begin writing his name down.
Knives come for the people beside him.
And the System itself starts demanding more — more risk, more claim, more women — or it will punish him for hesitation.
From the blood-stained streets of the lower district to the gates of a ruthless magic academy, Kai will build a harem not out of fantasy, but out of necessity, desire, and the simple truth that he is done being prey.…
madame-is-pretending-to-be-an-academic-s:
My wife is pretending to be a bad student again.
######
After raising a foolish wife for nineteen years, she left a divorce paper and ran away!
Sitting in a wheelchair, he looked calm: “She doesn't know the way, she won't get far.”
The subordinate reminded: “Madam has run abroad to compete...”
Young Master remained expressionless: “She is a bad student, always last in every competition.”
The subordinate wiped his sweat: “But, Madam is a judge this time...”
Mr. Emperor furrowed his brows: “Heh, what does a country girl know besides planting?”
The subordinate wanted to cry: “A global top academic competition... in the men's category... as a judge...”
He, who has a leg condition, suddenly stood up from the wheelchair: “I'll go compete!”
= =
At the competition venue.
Looking at his foolish wife dressed as a man, handsome and charming, dominating all the awards; then in a long dress, radiant and mesmerizing, becoming a goddess revered in the fields of global medicine, pharmacy, botany, and even astrophysics...…
marked-by-the-alphas-cursed-blue-moon:
Maria is the only daughter of Jackson, the Alpha of the prestigious Blue Moon Pack in Aberdeen, Scotland. Her mother, the Luna, was revered for her grace and strength. But despite her lineage, Maria's life has been far from perfect.
At seventeen, she couldn't shift into her wolf or sense her fated mate, a secret her parents kept hidden out of shame in the pack.
By nineteen, still unable to shift, she was forced into an engagement with Bernard, her childhood friend and the future Alpha of their pack, who already had a mate only Maria knows about.
Maria and Bernard attended the same college, where their engagement was the talk of the campus, earning Maria both admiration and envy.
Yet, behind the smiles, Maria's heart belonged to James Brooklyn, the next Alpha of the Crescent Moon Pack—the sworn rivals of her people.
Everything took a darker turn on the night of her engagement to Bernard when her parents were brutally murdered.
Will Maria survive the deadly power struggles within her pack, uncover the identity of her true mate, and claim the life she deserves?
Or will the curse of the Blue Moon destroy her and everyone she loves after finding out who killed her parents?
minor-god-system:
Astrael Luna was having a terrible Monday.
Overworked, underpaid, and already exhausted from dealing with his job, all Astrael wanted was to catch the last bus home, get some sleep, and forget the day ever happened.
Instead, the bus crashed.
His apartment flooded.
And somehow, there was an exposed wire waiting for him when he got home.
Then he died.
Normally, that would be the end of the story.
Except Astrael woke up in a strange realm, greeted by a humanoid figure made entirely of light, and informed that he had been selected to become a god.
A minor god, to be exact.
With twelve followers, a tiny domain, an absurd amount of responsibility, and a mysterious system that seems determined to drag him into the world of divinity, Astrael quickly realizes that becoming a god isn't nearly as simple as it sounds.
Especially when his first followers are living in a dying land, surrounded by a mysterious curse, and praying to any god desperate enough to listen.
Unfortunately for everyone involved, Astrael is listening.…
monster-academy-alchemy-of-souls:
In a world where angels and devils coexist within the halls of a magical academy, Strict rules must be obeyed in other to maintain Order and Chaos in the multiverse.
‎
‎Among them, one rule is unbreakable— and that rule is that no angel may fall in love or procreate with a devil. To break it means banishment from the supreme world and the council shall seize offender's powers and make them mortal.
‎
‎Valkyrie, a mysterious new student, who quickly bonds with fellow angels. But her heart betrays her when she begins to fall for Bulb— the thing is...Bulb is a devil and the strongest of it's kind.
‎
‎What neither of them know is that Valkyrie is no ordinary angel. She is a hybrid, a rare supernatural born with both angelic light and devilish shadow.
‎
‎When Valkyrie uncovers the truth about her parent's death at the hands of Venom— a devil turned demon, exiled from the academy a century ago, her destiny begins to change.
‎
‎With her friends and crew by her side and a forbidden love that could shatter worlds, Valkyrie must confront her heritage, challenge the ancient laws, and hunt down Venom.

monster-paradise:

mu-ryeongs-spirit:
Kim Mu-ryeong is the youngest member of a famous exorcist family.
He grew up receiving love from his entire family and was considered a genius.
The kind that appears once every hundred years.
“Mu-ryeong, let me make a request.”
After enrolling in high school, Mu-ryeong began to do simple exorcism work.
The apartment’s elevator is acting weird.
Someone is having constant nightmares.
Even things like getting rid of a stalker or acting as a boyfriend.
It was more of a problem-solver job than exorcism,
But Mu-ryeong, being someone who helped anybody,
There was nothing he couldn’t accept.
But even for Mu-ryeong, there was one person he avoided…
“Ki Hwan-young?”
Tall and handsome with a mysterious, intimidating aura,
And known for being impolite and having no friends.
One day, Ki Hwan-young came to see Mu-ryeong.
“My shoulders feel heavy lately.”
my-demon-friends:
Zhou Li has been able to see demons since he was young, but it wasn’t until the end of his senior year in high school that he actually came into contact with one.
“You can see me, right?”
“You must be able to see me!”
“You were looking at me just now!” The barefoot youth kept pace with Zhou Li.

“Hey! You're still pretending?”
my-professor-is-trying-to-make-me-her-bo:
I thought meeting a beautiful woman in the rain would be the most interesting thing that happened to me that week.
I was wrong.
The next morning, she walked into my classroom.
Professor Nicolette Anastasia Collins.
Twenty-eight years old. Brilliant. Wealthy. Beautiful enough to make half the department forget what they were doing — and somehow, she's already interested in me.
At first, I thought she was joking.
Then she asked for my number.
Then she began calling me after class.
Then she started inviting me to dinner.
And somehow, the woman who can casually discuss six-cylinder engines, teach engineering like she was born for it, and pay for dinner with a black card also happens to pout when I don't answer her calls.
She's my professor.
She's six years older than me.
She's completely out of my league.
And she's apparently decided that I'm going to be her boyfriend.
The worst part?
I'm not sure I want her to stop.
—

on-a-deserted-island-with-a-beauty:
On his first business trip, Chang Yuan was seated next to an absolute beauty.
He was prepared to have a passionate love life and end his boring single life.
However, he never imagined that their plane would crash and they would be stranded on a deserted island!
As he looked at the vast ocean around them, Chang Yuan wanted to cry.
The silver lining was that the beautiful woman had grabbed onto his clothes and was also stranded here.
Chang Yuan mumbled, “Wait a minute. I suddenly realize that you look very similar to a certain celebrity. What was her name again?”
“Is it Qiao Yuran?”
“Ah, yes. You look like the superstar, Qiao Yuran.”
She replied, “I am Qiao Yuran.”

one-wish-to-own-the-world:
“I wish to have the highest intelligence possible, an intelligence that would allow me to perceive and thoroughly understand everything I see, even if superficially and only once, to the fullest, including strong points, weak points, and how to overcome them.”
Due to a mistake done by God, Ken is born with every type of perfect memory, but without anything else - he is weak, sickly, stupid, and ugly.
However, there was a saving grace - he made a friend, Leo. Leo would talk to him about hypothetical situations like what to say in case a genie granted him one wish.
When Ken dies and God offers him one wish for his next life as compensation for his previous mistake, Ken simply recites Leo's words and is sent to the cultivation world. There, he slowly learns that he is the only one he can trust.

only-i-can-adapt-genetic-evolution-syste:
As of the year 2030, humanity is on the brink of collapse.
Three years ago, the “Fulminare” appeared from seemingly thin air. They appear to be human in every way, only possessing physical gifts superior in every fashion, some of which even wield supernatural abilities.
Only with a single soldier are they able to subjugate entire cities, perhaps only a small force from their world has been sent, as though Earth is nothing more than a side project for them.
The United is barely hanging by a thread, perhaps only by the Fulminare’s repeated demands of submission. All hope has been lost, except for one miraculous arrival, discovered in Death Valley, landing in a crater fit for a calamity:
A sphere, requesting to be bound to a host.
After countless tests and many deaths, a young, talentless man–”Seven”--is accepted by the sphere.
[Genetic Evolution System Activated.]
[Beginning genetic alteration.]
From a scrawny, small boy to an imposing man of perfect musculature, he shatters all world records from strength to speed, but even that is not enough for the Fulminare. He must adapt, evolving his genetic structure to face the overwhelming invaders.
parasite-planet-my-seaweed-controls-sss-:
One person in ten awakens at 18 and receives a planet of their own. Maverick received an ocean with no land and a single piece of seaweed.
The whole world laughed. His rivals got fire drakes and wolves of ice. He got a salad. He is the weakest, and the heir of the house that murdered his family did not even bother to look at him.
But no one can see another person’s talent, and his changes everything.
His seaweed doesn’t fight. It slides into the neck of a wounded beast, takes root in its brain, and takes control. The beast becomes his. Its skill becomes his too.
Fish. Monsters. Dragons. Even SSS-rank beasts.
There is only one problem.
The first creature his seaweed took was him.
rebirth-from-ordinary-person-to-the-stro:
“I don't want to die anymore, so I'll aim to be the strongest――!”
After being stabbed by a random attacker, he was reincarnated in Japan, a place where 'demons' like yokai and monsters exist――and moreover, he was born into a family of 'exorcists' who exorcise these monsters!
Exorcism is an important job that involves killing monsters, but it is also a dangerous job where people can die.
Therefore, he――Itsuki, made a decision.
In order to never die again, he would become strong.
He aimed to be the strongest and practiced magic tirelessly since he was a baby――until he realized.
“Huh? Isn't this too much?”
This is the story of an exorcist who, despite being an ordinary person, became the strongest without realizing it due to excessive effort.
school-beautys-invincible-martial-expert:
A tale of avenging a father’s murder harbored hidden circumstances.
A young man rose, a story steeped in bloodshed.
seventies-sweetheart-from-breakup-to-bil:
Food blogger Lin Xiang unexpectedly transmigrates into a male-centric period novel as the notorious villainess everyone wants to beat up.
Her father died early, her mother is blatantly biased, her brother is emotionally broken, and her original self was spoiled beyond reason.
To return to her own world, she must raise the favorability of the male lead, who, in the story, is actually her adoptive brother. The problem? His emotional damage was all caused by her.
The brother she picked up off the streets was treated like a beast of burden, and she constantly framed and mistreated him. His favorability rating? Deep in the negatives.
Now, Lin Xiang has no choice but to shower him with care and affection while tempting him daily with her culinary creations.
As a former food blogger, she quickly rises again in this new world, landing a job at a state-owned restaurant thanks to her signature pan-fried steak.
Everything seems to be getting better. Her brother’s attitude is softening, and she's even planning to matchmake the male and female leads to keep the plot on track… But to her horror, she realizes her brother's so-called familial affection is starting to take a very wrong turn!
sold-to-a-prince:
In the land of magic and beasts, Sylvia was betrayed by her family and sold off as a slave. She was expecting the worst, but fortunately, it was a handsome prince who had ‘bought’ her! Who doesn’t love a charming, benevolent, and kind prince, not to mention ridiculously handsome?
But, little did Sylvia know that the charming handsome prince was no angel but rather a devil in disguise!
The calm, kind and good-hearted Sylvia found herself slowly changing under the devil's influence but worst of all, she found herself becoming more and more addicted to the two-faced devil who harbored dark and dangerous secrets.
But could she ever fully trust the shameless devil? Or was he just one of the many who desired her hidden powers? Let the games begin!
.......................
Excerpt:
“Are you getting ready for your engagement, my sweet kitten?” The devil's familiar voice drawled, making Sylvia's entire body tingle with an unfathomable need.
She gazed into his dark coal black eyes, lost within them, as he rubbed her lips with his thumb. This man... This man in front of her alone had the power to make her knees weak and her heart crumble.
“Heh.…
soulforged-the-fusion-talent:
In a world shrouded in darkness and overrun by monsters born from a dead god, soldiers are nothing but disposable shields. Healing serums keep the wounded breathing long enough to die later, and only exceptional survivors earn a name.
Bright Morgan is thrown into the lowest regiment of cannon fodder—expected to die before his first campaign.
But he carries a rare soul talent: Fusion.
At first, he can only merge weapons. But when elite monsters fall and their crystal cores are collected, his talent evolves—allowing him to fuse powers themselves.
His first fusion?
Spatial Awareness + Danger Sense = Spatial Foresight.
He can sense killing intent, track unseen threats, and react before death arrives.
After watching the only friend he makes get slaughtered on patrol, Bright abandons hope and embraces cold pragmatism.
From the gutters of the battlefield, he begins climbing the power ladder:
Fledgling >Initiate >Adept> Expert >Elite >Champion >Mythic >Cosmic
To survive, he’ll steal, forge, kill, and evolve.
And in a world built on corpses, Bright Morgan won’t just live—
He’ll become the weapon that decides who does.
surviving-in-a-school-of-ghost-stories:
My younger brother died.
And it happened inside the prestigious private school that I struggled so hard to get him into.
As I was crying in despair in front of his grave,
A strange man who claimed to be the student council president appeared and made an unbelievable offer.
“Would you like to go back one year if you could?”
He seemed like a swindler, but faced with sudden despair, I had no other choice.
I grasped at this rotten lifeline and hastily made a deal with him.
And surprisingly, I really did go back one year in time.
Without wasting time, I immediately transferred to that problematic private school. To protect my younger brother who was still alive.
But this school, the atmosphere is not right.
Ghosts and spirits appear all over the school, and ‘ghost stories’ occur.
Somehow, my brother seems to be connected to these strange phenomena.
Will I, Melody Hastings, be able to safely solve the ghost story, protect my younger brother, and get out of this school?
sweet-adorable-wife-please-kiss-slower:
Lin Wanwan is a pitiful mentally-disabled girl. Not only does she suffer abuse from her stepmother, her stepmother even attempts to use her as a sexual commodity to pleasure others. Eventually, the poor Wanwan dies from an overdose...
Perhaps a god or a devil had witnessed her tragic fate, but Wanwan gets a brand new chance at life—an external soul takes over her body and gains Wanwan’s memories.
The resurrected Lin Xiao swears to seek revenge for Wanwan.
Having witnessed Wanwan’s death and resurrection process, Tang Chen is intrigued by the changes she undergoes. When he tries to cheat Wanwan to gain possession of her, a knight descends from the sky and saves her. He allows her to seek his help thrice.
Just who is this mysterious knight?
The revived Wanwan demonstrates her astounding talent and intelligence. Not only does she leave her enemies helpless against her, but she also becomes a celebrity who sweeps through the entertainment industry. Who exactly is she?
When Wanwan interacts more with the knight, she realizes that he is actually a devil...
“From this moment forth, every inch of your body is mine. Resistance is futile.…
the-aftermath-of-having-slept-with-the-v:
When the female support (cannon fodder) slept with the villain, they all had miserable ends.
But what about when the female support changes to Xue Xue?
The ending naturally becomes different.
the-arrogant-immortal:
After two-hundred years of diligent cultivation, Xie Jiuniang successfully achieved Core Formation, yet on that very night, she was killed by her dual-cultivation partner Lin Wangchen.
However, Xie Jiuniang was reborn... and she accidentally discovered a great secret.
It turned out that in her previous life, she was a child deeply favored by the Heavenly Dao, watched over by some top forces who secretly stole her opportunities time and again, fattening up the esteemed talents of the Cultivation World, with that scum being just one of them.
The weak, pitiable, and helpless Xie Jiuniang decided to first become a dark horse, secretly sweeping away all the opportunities.
And so...
The favored talents were dumbfounded, “Where did my opportunity go?”
Her scumbag ex-husband felt wronged, “ ...She didn't like me.…
the-beautiful-time-with-you:
Shortly after his marriage, Lin Jiage was thrown out of his house.
In his quest to return home, he tried every means at his disposal, but to no avail. Eventually, he could only turn his sights to a certain Little Bun.
After listening to Lin Jiage’s proposal, Little Bun shook pinkies with him and replied in an adorable voice, “Deal!”
Thus…
On the night that Little Bun received a robot, he brought Shi Yao to a restaurant and secretly whispered into Lin Jiage’s ears, “Daddy, Mommy is here to eat with you.”
On the night that Little Bun received an Ultraman figurine, he brought Shi Yao to a swimming complex and whispered into Lin Jiage’s ears, “Daddy, Mommy is here to swim with you.”
On the night that Little Bun received a toy train set, he brought Shi Yao to a hotel room, gave Lin Jiage a condom, and whispered into his ear, “Daddy, Mommy is here to sleep with you.”
the-best-assassin-incarnated-into-a-diff:
The eldest son of the assassin aristocrat Tuatha Dé.
The skill, experience, knowledge of the previous life, magic, all of which grows his power as an assassin.
Excellent assassins pass through. He was usually admired as the ideal lord, and behind it wielded a blade as an assassin aristocrat.
the-comeback-of-the-charming-farmers-wif:
(The Book's title has been changed from the original Pretty Man's Beloved Farmwife: This Madam is So Hot). Yang Chuxia found herself in a different world, inhabiting the body of a destitute farm girl who had been killed by her step-grandmother. To make matters worse, her step-grandmother even intended to sell her lifeless body. How could she endure such a fate?
Hmph, whether you're a step-grandmother or an uncle, if you're a villain, I'll confront you just the same. Send one, I'll defeat one; send two, I'll conquer both.
Yet, after vanquishing the wrongdoers, she gazed upon her emaciated, poorly dressed parents, siblings, and the struggling, underdeveloped village.
Yang Chuxia seethed with determination, pointing to the sky and declaring, “I shall surely bring prosperity to this place, to the point where you'll fear having flowers bloom in summer when I tell you to have flowers blooming in summer, and where you are too afraid to seek women for me as suitors, when I tell you to find me men!”
A certain man whispered, “Wifey, I'm already a man...”
the-discarded-sons-skill-market:
Betrayed, poisoned, and cast aside like trash by his own family.
Zaid Zachary has been sentenced to death in the Waste Gates, but fate had a unique opportunity in store for him: the [Talent Copy Shop System].
S-Rank talent? Check.
My brother's humiliation? Paid back with interest.
The fiancée who betrayed me? Just another step on the way.
In a world where talents define your status, Zaid has the power to possess them all.
the-forgotten-ladys-little-farm:
My Golden Space Turns a Neglected Courtyard into a Kingdom
Lin Yue has always believed in one simple rule:
Water first. Shelter second. Food third. Everything else comes after.
In her previous life, she was an environmental science graduate and wilderness-survival content creator who knew how to turn almost any patch of wilderness into something livable. She understood soil, plants, water, sanitation, construction, preservation, accounting, and practical engineering.
She never expected to need those skills after dying and awakening in the body of a twenty-year-old noblewoman.
Unfortunately, Lin Yue's new life isn't exactly luxurious.
She has transmigrated into the body of the forgotten Fourth Miss of a wealthy household—a daughter nobody remembers, nobody particularly cares about, and nobody expects to accomplish anything.
Her inheritance?
An abandoned eastern courtyard.
Her possessions?
Almost nothing.
Her household?
One nervous maid named Qiao'er.
Her future?
Bleak.
Then Lin Yue discovers something even stranger.
A tiny supernatural space exists within her consciousness.…
the-hidden-alpha-brothers-are-mine:
This Book is strictly 18+. It contains explicit sex scenes and violence.
___
Davina had always longed for love. Branded an outcast at school and blamed for her father’s death, even her mother abandoned her for a new life of happiness, leaving Davina trapped in a dead end with no way out.
Thrown into the household of a cruel Alpha as his unwanted stepdaughter, Davina unexpectedly gained something else; three broken Alpha brothers.
Shawn’s coldness made her thirst for more of his touch which sent chills down her spine. Uriel’s smile and warmth made her want to be locked under the sheets with him all day. And Ethan’s mischievousness made her look forward to the pleasure she would get every night.
Despite the family tension, Davina found herself drawn to them, ensnared by their presence, and overwhelmed by a dangerous desire she couldn’t control. But life was far from merciful.
When life pushed her to the wall, she fought back, shaming those who had written her off. She became a strong full-blooded wolf but at what cost? Bodies and secrets lined her path to the top with the love she managed to find slipping out of her hands.
the-return-of-the-seventh-young-lady:
“Mu Yingying,” or the Seventh Young Lady of the Mu family, vividly remembers the cruel past life she endured.
Due to the evil schemes of her stepmother and half-sister, the three descendants of the Mu family met tragic ends...
The eldest son died dishonorably, the eldest daughter became mentally deranged,
And she, the second daughter, was unjustly sentenced to death!
Even her own father heartlessly cast his children aside...
Now, she has returned once again, to the third year of the Xingping era, when “Mu Yingying” was only 5 years old.
She has come back to the starting point of everything!
Very well... She will drag the traitors down into the depths of hell.
Her return is not for forgiveness... but to reclaim what is rightfully hers and to exact retribution on those who wronged her!
“Death is not the end, but the beginning of the regret you will face.”
the-wealthy-tycoons-game-of-life:
After graduating from college and unsure of where to go, Zhou Wang accidentally activated the “Game of Life” system while playing a video game, turning his life into easy mode from then on.
We can't return to the past, but we can always change the way we live.
Growing through indulgence, advancing with a carefree spirit.
...
Zhou Wang: “This time, I'll only be the winner.”

top-sexy-girl-group:
Sian Lee, the strongest person under the heavens in old china, was reborn as a very overweight woman.
Now, behold as you watch the change that is about to occur!
transmigrated-into-fractured-dawn-as-the:
The narrative follows a gamer who, after selecting the “Awakened Cinder” class in the game Fractured Dawn, finds himself transported into the game's world. However, this version of the game is devoid of its usual interfaces—no UI, no tutorials, and no second chances. Each death strips away a part of his memories and identity, immersing him deeper into a perilous reality.
The protagonist, now known as Riven, must navigate the treacherous Witherlands, confronting formidable foes like the Gravemare and Dreamborn Horrors, while uncovering the mysteries of Emberlight, Grace, and Cindershrines. His journey is one of survival, self-discovery, and challenging the very fabric of this fractured world.
transmigrated-into-the-world-of-magic-an:
What would happen if a genius martial artist transmigrated into the world of swords and magic?
Will he become the Ruler of the new world?
Or
Will he become the prey to the strong like a side character?
Leon, a genius martial artist, was struck by lightning when he was on his way home.
When the doctor said he was paralyzed from shoulder to foot, all martial artists cheered in happiness and held a party.
Leon was a candidate to be the Ruler, so they were thrilled when they found out that he could no longer be a martial artist because they were scared by his extraordinary and unreasonable talent.
They wanted to continue to be bosses in their regions and become idols for everyone, so news of his condition was like a heavenly song to their ears.
The world's cruelty to Leon did not stop there.
When a powerful earthquake shook the hospital violently, none of the doctors or nurses tried to save him, leaving him with no choice but to accept his fate as walls and medical equipment collapsed on him.
But when he thought he was dead, he found himself transmigrated into a parallel world where monsters and powerful people ruled the world.…
tsundere-campus-goddess-and-rogue-master: Wang Xiao was compelled to descend from the mountain by his master, with his intrinsic energy cloistered, and a lovely woman erroneously believing him to be her betrothed. In a bid to safeguard his mistakenly assigned fiancée, he resolved to remain in the school teeming with enchanting beauties. With the same intent to defend his intended, he managed to transform the currents of power within the city.
